resources.string: Edit the background and six buttons, then choose an AI wallpaper to replace
Uses the bottom-right slot. App names and icons will be visible while locked.
Choose an AI wallpaper you no longer plan to use. The original will be backed up so you can restore it.
Connect Shizuku on the rear screen tab to view local AI wallpapers.
No readable AI wallpapers on this device.
Could not read the wallpapers. Check Shizuku or reload the list.
Could not save the image. The previous background was kept.
Backed up and replaced. Apply the same work in Xiaomi rear screen settings, then return here to prepare.
Original files restored. Reselect the original wallpaper in the system rear screen settings.
Another edit was detected. Nothing was overwritten and the backup was kept.
The file change could not be verified. Keep Shizuku connected and retry Restore here before uninstalling ReMRSS.
Apply the wallpaper and prepare shortcuts to use them with the main screen locked. Restore the original before applying a different layout.
Only the selected work is replaced. Apply it again in the system rear screen settings. Choose apps you are comfortable opening while the main screen is locked.
Choose an app for every visible app shortcut.
No matching apps available for casting.
Could not open this app on the rear screen
Lift all fingers from the rear screen to continue.
Ready. Tap an app on the wallpaper with the main screen locked.
Apply the selected work in Xiaomi rear screen settings, then unlock and prepare here.
Could not prepare shortcuts. Check Shizuku, unlock the main screen and close any existing rear cast.
Turn on virtual casting in Casting and display first.
Load the background and layout from a ZIP Mod without changing your applied wallpaper.
Template loaded into the draft. Review the app shortcuts.
Could not open the template. Select a signed ZIP Mod containing one valid rear wallpaper template.
